entities.summary: Jordi Sabater Pi was a Spanish primatologist and specialist in ethology. Sabater was known for describing the cultural behaviors of several species, including the use of tools by chimpanzees. During the 1960s, he purchased Snowflake, a very rare albino gorilla and transported him to Barcelona Zoo, where he lived until his death in 2003.
